data.gender_notes: Demott is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'dēmos' (people) and 'metron' (measure), Demott means 'God's judge'. In ancient Greece, demotes were leaders or judges of the people, making this name a fitting choice for a child who is destined to serve and protect their community. The name Demott carries the meaning “God's judge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Demott usually hope their child will grow to embody god's judge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
